title: Choose the dashboard direction
question: A phone-first daily shift, with more useful space on desktop.

options.label: Shift Folio
options.thesis: A crisp daily shift slip beside an ordered monthly roster.
options.viewport: Your date and shift lead on a phone; desktop pairs the daily card with the full month.
options.risk: The light surface is a deliberate change from the current dark app.

raised.raise: Typography and selection carry hierarchy without extra framing.
Shift numerals stay clearly readable at a glance.
Every control has a consistent, explicit state.
Selection stays synchronized across card and calendar.
One composition adapts instead of accumulating panels.

options.label: Crew Terminal
options.thesis: Typed commands and warning chrome obscure quick touch actions.
options.risk: Typed commands and warning chrome obscure quick touch actions.
options.case: Declined on both audience fit and immediate task clarity.

options.label: Metro Roster
options.thesis: Oversized cropped text and panorama navigation weaken complete date visibility.
options.risk: Oversized cropped text and panorama navigation weaken complete date visibility.
options.case: Declined on both audience fit and immediate task clarity.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.thesis: Glyph-axis navigation has no shift-scheduling equivalent.
options.risk: Glyph-axis navigation has no shift-scheduling equivalent.
options.case: Declined on both audience fit and immediate task clarity.

options.label: Signal Bench
options.thesis: Channels and instrument controls add interpretation to a simple schedule.
options.risk: Channels and instrument controls add interpretation to a simple schedule.
options.case: Declined on both audience fit and immediate task clarity.

options.label: Alphabet Storm
options.thesis: Transforming letterforms work against reading a shift immediately.
options.risk: Transforming letterforms work against reading a shift immediately.
options.case: Declined on both audience fit and immediate task clarity.

options.label: Drawcord
options.thesis: Shape manipulation distracts from selecting exact dates.
options.risk: Shape manipulation distracts from selecting exact dates.
options.case: Declined on both audience fit and immediate task clarity.

canonCard.label: Conventional calendar
canonCard.thesis: A familiar calendar app, with the daily shift above the month.
canonCard.viewport: Standard date grid and a selected-day panel.
canonCard.risk: Familiar by design, with less individual character.
